verdict.rationale: Salv documents one built-in AI capability, AI-Powered Insights, which adjudicates sanctions name matches and explains its reasoning. That is a narrow analysis task the AI performs inside the product. It is explicitly informational only: it never closes an alert or makes a decision, and nothing describes a general assistant users can hand tasks to. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant, the ability to delegate actions (e.g. closing alerts, drafting cases, configuring scenarios) to it, a conversational or instruction-based interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI-Powered Insights adjudicates a name match and explains its reasoning, but it's informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision.
